title: CHED CertificateUpdated event (v1)
description: Event emitted when a TRACES CHED certificate snapshot is observed or republished. Certificate aggregate; CHED family is on subType (CHEDA | CHEDP | CHEDPP | CHEDD). data is the full CHED profile. When present, TRACES LAST_UPDATE_DATETIME is copied to data.exchangedDocument.revisionDateTime and kept in includedNote.

subType.description: TRACES CHED type for this Certificate aggregate. Derived from the CHED_TYPE note (contentCode A/P/PP/D → CHEDA/CHEDP/CHEDPP/CHEDD). Canonical discriminator for consumers; the CHED_TYPE note is retained on data.exchangedDocument.includedNote for round-trip.
